Opened by mkowalczyk on 2026-09-08

I clicked "Forgot password" on the login page. The email arrived within a
minute, but the link in it goes to

    http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=…

which of course doesn't load for me. Two people on m

args.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email link currently uses a hardcoded fallback base URL of http://localhost:3000 if the PUBLIC_URL environment variable is not set. This causes reset links in emails to point to localhost when run in deployment without PUBLIC_URL configured. Update the documentation or code to ensure that the correct public URL environment variable is set in deployed environments so the reset link is valid for end users.
args.title: Fix password reset email link to use correct base URL
